title: One Log, Then Another
beat: The crane lowers wood into the stake trailer.
alt: The beaver lowers another log into the trailer while PinPin watches from the tractor cab.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. At reference 1's exact woodland logging clearing, walk the camera around to the trailer's REAR-RIGHT corner, 1.5 metres high, looking diagonally along its open bed toward the tractor cab. Show the next loading step clearly: TWO oak logs already lie lengthwise on the trailer bed BETWEEN its stakes, and the yellow crane lowers a THIRD bark-covered log gently beside them, securely held at its middle by the black grapple. This is a deliberate wide view of the whole trailer and articulated crane, with red tractor cab beyond at left, root mass and remaining ground logs farther left, narrow stream beyond right. Both friends from reference 2 remain in their seats inside the parked cab: beaver driver in blue vest at crane controls, small PinPin watching. Small readable faces through glass; nobody outside. Log scale and weight feel substantial, tyres planted on dry bank, no motion blur. Detailed storybook realism, cool green shadows and soft late-morning light, textured bark/steel/rubber. Landscape1536x1024, continuous single scene, no text.
review: Accepted wide loading frame: two logs seated between trailer stakes, third held by connected grapple; both friends inside cab and no ground-level exposure to load. Driver is turned toward rear work, appropriate for loading. Steering/control details differ from interior reference, so this establishes illustrative action rather than an exact control layout. The crane tip is clipped at top by the chosen close-wide framing; load and grip remain fully visible.
